body: Document the finalized retrieval and freshness behavior. Embedding providers are independent contracts ordered Ollama Nomic, Ollama Qwen, then Gemini, with provider-owned dimensions defaulting to 768 and dimension-mismatch indexing rebuilding derived vector tables before re-embedding source content. Query confidence is a deterministic retrieval-evidence score rather than one minus cosine distance. Explicit recency questions rank creation time first within semantic recall. Ordinary capture obeys the Session auto-maintenance threshold and cooldown, while SessionStart forces one bounded drain of leftover Experience Log rows so a short prior session is not stranded; running-job and lock guards still prevent duplicate workers.
creator: operator
rationale: These committed architectural changes directly affect operator expectations, query interpretation, fallback behavior, and new-session continuity, and the existing inbox source predates their final form.
title: Current embedding, confidence, and SessionStart freshness contracts
